newsitem.title: UK: Hepworth shares slide on personnel change.
newsitem.headline: Hepworth shares slide on personnel change.

text.p: Heating and building materials group Hepworth Plc released favourable first-half results and an upbeat outlook on Friday but its shares slid on disappointment about the departure of a key executive, traders said.
Hepworth stock dropped as low as 282p in early dealings but pared losses to trade at 286p by 0728 GMT, down 5-1/2p on the day. The overall market was steady.

"The interim figures were very good, we cannot fault them or the outlook. But it seems the departure of Jean-Francois Chene (head of Hepworth Saunier Duval) has upset the market...he was regarded as a key player at Hepworth," one market maker said.

Dealers said they were surprised at the share's weakness after the group released six-month profits which just exceeded the top end of forecasts. Pretax profit dropped to 35.5 million stg from 37.5 million a year earlier.
"The only negative thing we can find in this statement is Chene's leaving...The share drop seems a bit overdone though, given the strength of the figures," a second marketmaker said.
Hepworth predicted "steady progress" this year on the back of improved growth prospects across Europe, which it said should stimulate new construction and home improvement spending.
